notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
The next update brings these novelties.
-Support for OpenGL-light upgrade in the main menu.
-New dialogues for the Home Compass puzzle.
-Slight changes in dialogues.
-Possibility to skip the introduction (Escape key).

* Unfortunately this new update breaks the previously saved games
